## Japan visa application

Fill in each **NEEDS-YOU** item directly on your form. Where applicability is uncertain, check whether the item applies before filling it in.

**[B01] Surname**

SURNAME_P1

**[B02] Given and middle names**

GIVEN_P1

MIDDLE_P1

After the names are restored, put them together in this field in the order and spelling shown in your passport.

**[B03] Other names** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter any other names you use or have used, or write “None” if you have none.

**[B04] Date of birth**

DATE_P1

After restoration, write the date in day/month/year order if needed.

**[B05] Place of birth**

PLACE_P1

After restoration, enter the city, state or province, and country in the corresponding spaces. NEEDS-YOU for any applicable component missing from the stored value.

**[B06] Sex** — Tick Female.  
**[B07] Marital status** — Tick Single.  
**[B08] Nationality or citizenship** — Filipino.  
**[B09] Former or other nationalities or citizenships** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter any that apply, or write “None” if you have none.  
**[B10] Government-issued ID number** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm which government ID number applies and enter it directly on the form.  
**[B11] Passport type** — NEEDS-YOU. Check your passport and tick the matching type.

**[B12] Passport number**

ID_P1

**[B13] Place of issue** — NEEDS-YOU. The issuing country is the Philippines. Check your passport for the place of issue to enter.

**[B14] Date of issue**

ISSUED_P1

After restoration, write the date in day/month/year order if needed.

**[B15] Issuing authority**

AUTHORITY_P1

**[B16] Date of expiry** — 13/03/2032.  
**[B17] Certificate of Eligibility number** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether this applies and enter the number if applicable.  
**[B18] Purpose of visit** — Holiday (tourism).  
**[B19] Intended length of stay** — 10 days.  
**[B20] Date of arrival** — 02/04/2027.  
**[B21] Port of entry** — Narita International Airport.  
**[B22] Ship or airline** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the airline for your flight into Narita.  
**[B23] Hotel names and telephone numbers** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the name and telephone number of each hotel once booked.  
**[B24] Hotel addresses** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the address of each hotel once booked.  
**[B25] Previous stays in Japan** — None.

**[B26] Current residential address**

ADDRESS_P1

Use the restored home address if it is current. NEEDS-YOU for any other current residential address, or for your current address if the stored one is outdated.

**[B27] Telephone and mobile**

PHONE_P1

Put the restored number under “Mobile No.” if it is a mobile number, or under “Tel.” if it is a landline. NEEDS-YOU for a second number if applicable.

**[B28] Email** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your email address.  
**[B29] Current occupation and position** — Staff nurse.  
**[B30] Employer name and telephone** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your employer’s name and telephone number.  
**[B31] Employer address** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your employer’s address.  
**[B32] Partner’s or parents’ occupation** — NEEDS-YOU if applicable. This item is optional.  
**[B33] Guarantor or reference in Japan** — NEEDS-YOU. If applicable, enter the person’s name, telephone, address, date of birth, sex, relationship to you, occupation and position, nationality, and immigration status.  
**[B34] Inviter in Japan** — NEEDS-YOU. If you have an inviter and they are also your guarantor, write “same as above.” If someone else invited you, provide the details requested in B33 for that person.  
**[B35] Remarks or special circumstances** — NEEDS-YOU if you have anything to add. This item is optional.

**[B36] Criminal conviction** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No.  
**[B37] Imprisonment sentence of one year or more** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No and follow Note 2 about suspended sentences.  
**[B38] Deportation or removal** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No.  
**[B39] Drug conviction and sentence** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No and follow Note 2 about suspended sentences.  
**[B40] Prostitution or related activity** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No.  
**[B41] Trafficking in persons or involvement in it** — NEEDS-YOU. Tick Yes or No.  
**[B42] Details of any Yes answers** — NEEDS-YOU if you ticked Yes in B36–B41. Enter the relevant details.  
**[B43] Date of application** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the actual application date in day/month/year order.  
**[B44] Applicant’s signature** — NEEDS-YOU. Sign the form yourself after reviewing it.
